paragraphs: Lakeside Renovations is a small home remodeling South Milwaukee team. When you hire them, the same two people who quote the job are the ones laying your floor or rebuilding your bathroom, and reviewers notice. One called them two amazing fellas.

The jobs are the rooms you use every day: bathroom remodels, tile, and new floors through living rooms and hallways. Every review on Google gives five stars, and the same words keep coming up: quality work, professional, punctual, beautiful. One homeowner joked that his wife was ready to divorce him over what they had spent on the living room, until she saw what these two did with it.

about.text: Lakeside Renovations LLC is a remodeling company serving South Milwaukee, Wisconsin. It is a small operation: customers describe a crew of two, and the work comes from the same pair from the first day to the last. Their jobs include bathroom remodels, tile and flooring, and whole living room updates. Every Google review so far is five stars, with homeowners praising the quality of the work, the professionalism and the fact that the crew shows up on time. They are open six days a week, Monday to Saturday, so a weekday or Saturday call usually reaches them.

image.alt: Wood-look vinyl planks being laid across a living room subfloor during installation

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Phone (414) 578-6916 Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM, and tell us about the room you want to change.

steps.title: Look and plan
steps.text: We come out, look at the space and talk through materials, layout and what the job will involve.

steps.title: The work
steps.text: The two of us do the work ourselves, showing up on time and keeping you in the loop as the room comes together.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: We walk the finished room with you so you can check every detail before we pack up and leave.

service_area.h2: Home remodeling in South Milwaukee, WI
service_area.text: Lakeside Renovations is a service-area business listed on Google in South Milwaukee, Wisconsin, so the crew comes to you rather than working from a showroom. If you are in South Milwaukee or close by and want a bathroom, tile or flooring project done, call (414) 578-6916 between 9 AM and 5 PM, Monday to Saturday, and ask whether your address is in range.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: Mostly bathroom remodels, tile and flooring, plus the work that goes with updating a room, like the living room project shown on this page. If you are not sure whether your job is a fit for a two-man crew, call (414) 578-6916 and describe it. We will tell you straight.

items.q: Who will actually be in my home?
items.a: Lakeside Renovations is a small crew of two, and reviewers describe the same two people doing their work from start to finish. Customers remember them as 'these two guys', which tells you how personal the service is, and you always know who to ask when you have a question.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 9 AM to 5 PM and closed on Sunday. Saturday hours make it easier to talk if you work during the week. The best way to reach us is a phone call to (414) 578-6916 during those hours.

Lakeside Renovations is listed on Google as serving South Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and we travel to our customers' homes. If you live nearby and are not sure whether you are in our area, give us a call with your address and project and we will let you know.

items.q: How do I get a price for my project?
items.a: Call (414) 578-6916 and tell us about the room, the size and what you want done. We will arrange a time to look at it in person, talk through the options and then give you a price for the work before anything starts.
